poem.content:
In the siege of my heart, a good soul resides
A bonus of love, that forever abides
A letter of hope, written in the night
A beacon of light, that shines with all its might

But the issue of darkness, it still remains
A shadow that follows, with its constant pains
I search for an olive branch, to soothe my soul
A symbol of peace, that makes my heart whole

In my inquiry, I seek to understand
The increase of pain, that takes its stand
Like a jelly-like fear, it clings to my heart
A reminder of the wolf, that never departs

But I am myself, a kitten brave and true
I select the path, that leads me anew
I claim the prize, of a heart that's free
A main course of love, that's served to me

In the doll's gaze, I see a reflection true
A reminder of innocence, that's lost in me too
But still I hold on, to the good that remains
A bonus of love, that still sustains

The siege of my heart, it slowly subsides
As I increase my faith, in the love that abides
The wolf's howl fades, as I find my way
To a place of peace, where love stays.
